acceptanceReadbacks.ssot: 03_api_contract_complete.yaml Quote and QuoteLine — amountUSDMicros is the line total, all line amounts are non-negative, and total = sum(compute, storage, product) minus sum(adjustment_credit).
acceptanceReadbacks.implementation: catalog/quotes.go builds the lines from the resolved price version and sumQuoteLines applies the rule with checked additions.
acceptanceReadbacks.case: A quote through the real BFF process for the published pair totals 52580001 micro-dollars; a credit larger than its charges, a negative line and an overflowing sum are refused.

acceptanceReadbacks.ssot: 06_data_flow_and_state_machine.md:60-65 — the catalogue generates an immutable quote; a quote is not a capacity reservation and not a charge; acceptance binds exactly one operation and Workspace stores only the returned snapshot.
acceptanceReadbacks.implementation: CreateQuote stores the immutable offer with its policy versions, expiry and admission basis; AcceptQuote locks the row, binds one obligation and returns the acceptance identity and snapshot digest.
acceptanceReadbacks.case: The same obligation replays the identical acceptance; a second obligation is refused; an expired offer is refused; an unknown offer is absent; a resize or renew request is refused with the gap named.

acceptanceReadbacks.ssot: 01_domain_ownership_matrix.md — the Resource Catalog owns policy and quote facts only; it does not own resource execution, wallet accounting or the accepted subscription.
acceptanceReadbacks.implementation: the owner writes resource_catalog.quotes and quote_items; it charges nothing, reserves nothing and writes no subscription row.
acceptanceReadbacks.case: The owner-boundary tests assert the money rule and the refusals without any wallet, provider or subscription write.

acceptanceReadbacks.ssot: 01_domain_ownership_matrix.md — each owner has its own database and role; cross-owner references are opaque and no owner reads another's tables.
acceptanceReadbacks.implementation: reads are tenant-scoped inside this owner's own database; only the verified Workspace peer may call AcceptQuote.
acceptanceReadbacks.case: Another tenant's quote is absent rather than resolved, and a Catalog peer is refused the acceptance.

acceptanceReadbacks.ssot: The contract's public vocabulary applies to the owner's own policy message, not only to the request.
acceptanceReadbacks.implementation: the frozen plan-change policy this owner attaches to every price version is published in the contract's vocabulary.
acceptanceReadbacks.case: A focused test asserts all twelve declared properties are published, because a required property with no published form would make every stored price version unreadable to a caller.

proven: A member obtains a priced deploy quote through the running Console BFF process and reads it back; the owner's row is the authority for the total the process served.
The quote binds the single effective price, refund and retention version for the exact approved plan pair, and no fallback rate is used when the pair is unpriced.
The money rule is the contract's: quantity is explanatory only, credits reduce the total, and a credit larger than its charges, a negative line or an overflowing sum is refused.

AcceptQuote binds one offer to exactly one obligation, replays the identical acceptance for the same obligation, refuses a second obligation, refuses an expired offer and reports an unknown offer as absent.
An expired offer is reported as expired on read without rewriting the stored row.
resize and renew are refused with the gap named rather than answered with a deploy-shaped offer; the plan-change acceptance path is refused for the same reason.
The owner's own frozen policy message is publishable in the contract's vocabulary.
The full local gate passes at zero PostgreSQL skips on the frozen revision with a clean tracked worktree.
notProven: No Workspace owner exists yet, so nothing has actually accepted a quote: no Workspace, subscription, original order, resource intent or operation exists. The Catalog side of that edge is verified against a Workspace peer identity in the harness, not against a running Workspace process.
No Fabric resource set, compute, storage, attachment or Secret binding is created or read back, and no Local-Docker resource reference exists. There is no Local deployment loop.
resize and renew quoting, plan change, renewal and full deletion are out of scope for this slice.
The Ledger DomainInbox still accepts only tenant-scoped build and capability producers, so the platform-scoped catalog.policy_changed.v1 delivery stays pending.
The platform-administrator-versus-member read of the customer plan list remains an unresolved contract decision point.
No Candidate, Product Release, deployment or Instance qualification was performed; no production resource, credential or customer money was touched.
This branch's dependency stack is not yet on main, so the branch's diff against main still includes the shared writer's commits.
